steps.title: Include wheels and handles
steps.body: Measure the whole bag: the longest side, the width, and the height, including wheels and handles.

steps.title: Measure three sides
steps.body: Use centimetres. Write down length, width, and height before you add them.

steps.title: Enter the three numbers
steps.body: Add the three sides. 160 cm is the usual limit; 161 cm needs a reserved space.

steps.title: JR Central rule
steps.body: The result uses JR Central oversized-baggage rules, not a guess.
